rules.name: Spark Batch Job Execution Failure
rules.description: Fires when a scheduled batch job (Silver/Gold/Master Menu) terminates with non-zero exit code or fails to commit snapshot.
rules.resolution_condition: Next job execution finishes with exit code 0 and commits successfully.

rules.name: Stream Freshness High Lag / Ingestion Delay
rules.description: Fires when time since last received transaction event exceeds 30 minutes during operating hours or consumer offset backlog exceeds 100 messages.
rules.resolution_condition: New transaction ingested and freshness drops below 300 seconds.

rules.name: Infrastructure Container or Host Resource Critical
rules.description: Fires when any critical Docker container exits/reports unhealthy or host RAM usage exceeds 90%.
rules.resolution_condition: All services return running/healthy and memory drops below 85%.
